svg.title: Omaparallels
svg.desc: Animated overview of Omaparallels. A MacBook runs Omarchy full screen in Parallels Desktop, with Omarchy's Rose Pine Dawn bar and tiled windows. First, a small strip standing for the Mac's own menu bar appears above the laptop and its Wi-Fi and volume reach Omarchy's bar over the private Parallels network: the bar's Wi-Fi and volume icons light up and a Wi-Fi menu lists the Mac's real network and nearby networks. Next, the volume-up key on the Mac keyboard is pressed three times and Omarchy shows its own volume popup, rising each time, instead of the macOS one. Then three fingers swipe left on the trackpad and the desktop slides from workspace 1 to workspace 2. Finally an external display joins: the laptop moves aside, the display shows a second Omarchy monitor with its own bar and workspaces, and a small diagram shows the VM's monitors snapping into the same arrangement as in macOS System Settings, so the pointer crosses from one screen to the other where you expect. The loop then starts again.

g.text: the Mac's Wi-Fi and sound, in Omarchy's bar
another display, the same arrangement as macOS
